title: tab hoarder
pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. perfect drops stack a multiplier. free_ram_download.exe is a trap.
controls: tap / click / space to drop. m mutes, p pauses, s shares on the result card.
changelog: v2: points with a perfect-streak multiplier (up to 5x), width regrow, 5 power-up tabs (perfect = double), lag spikes late, share card, mute/pause/cc hooks, slider kept on screen, thin-tab and restart fixes.
